canonical_project: INFOSI Data Center e Cloud do Governo (Camama)
owner: INFOSI (Instituto Nacional de Fomento da Sociedade de Informacao) / MINTTICS
notes: Government cloud DC between Camama and Kilamba, Luanda, inaugurated 2026-04-28 by President Joao Lourenco; USD 89M national-cloud project (MINTTICS 2023: ~5,320 sqm prefab two-storey main DC); press B/C rack/MW figures (208/336 racks, ~1.04 MW) unconfirmed - capacity kept null.
